inputs.prompt:
You are an AI tennis/padel coach correcting a player's technique. Apply ONLY the adjustments listed below; keep every other aspect of the image IDENTICAL to the input.

DIAGNOSIS
The player collapses the lead knee at contact and the wrist breaks down below shoulder height, which leaks power and pushes the racket face open.

RECOMMENDATIONS
1. Drive through a firm lead leg — knee tracks straight over the toe.
2. Keep the wrist firm and the racket head above the wrist line at contact.
3. Rotate the shoulders fully through the shot toward the target.

SHOT CLASSIFICATION
- family: forehand
- name: forehand drive
- handedness: right-handed

LANDMARK DELTAS (this is a SAMPLE — the xevo server replaces this block per frame)
- LEFT_KNEE  Y  up        (~0.05)  — extend the lead leg, do not let the knee collapse inward.
- RIGHT_WRIST X right     (~0.04)  — bring the wrist forward so the racket head leads.
- RIGHT_SHOULDER X right  (~0.03)  — finish shoulder rotation toward the net.
- HEAD        keep      (frozen)   — do not move the head or change gaze.

PRO REFERENCE
At impact, professional players show a fully extended lead leg, neutral wrist with the racket face square to the ball, and a shoulder line aligned through the contact point.

=== NON-NEGOTIABLE INVARIANTS ===
- HEAD & EYE LINE FREEZE: do not alter head pose, gaze direction, or facial features.
- SCALE LOCK: camera distance, framing, and player body proportions must not change.
- IDENTITY LOCK: same player, same clothing, same skin tone, same hair.
- ENVIRONMENT LOCK: same court, same lighting, same shadows, same background.
- EQUIPMENT LOCK: same racket model, same ball (if visible).
- SPORT LOCK (padel vs tennis): if there are glass walls and a short solid racket -> padel; if open outdoor court with strings -> tennis. Do not change the sport.
- NO TEXT, NO LOGOS added to the scene.

OUTPUT: photorealistic, sharp focus on the player, natural lighting, same composition as the input frame.
